newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Swiss arrested in Senegal over porn photos.
newsitem.headline: Swiss arrested in Senegal over porn photos.

text.p: A Swiss national has been arrested in Senegal on charges of taking pornographic photographs of African women, the official news agency APS reported on Monday.
Police, quoted by APS, said the man had paid Senegalese and other African women to pose naked or in suspender belts and stockings. The agency did not give the suspect's name.
Under Senegalese law, anyone convicted of pornography faces between five and 10 years in jail.
